title: BestAgent clarifies viewing charges amid board resignation
summary:
Property portal BestAgent has issued a statement addressing concerns over viewing charges, property listings, and anonymous comments following the resignation of Yopa chief executive Verona Frankish from its advisory board. The clarification comes after a week of criticism over the platform's business practices and handling of agent relationships.

title: Shawbrook provides £3.37m exit finance for Plumstead homes
summary:
Shawbrook has provided a £3.37m development exit finance facility to ID Partnership Ltd for an eight-home residential development in Plumstead, South East London. The 12-month facility operates at 70% loan-to-value against a gross development value of approximately £4.82m.

title: Five character properties listed across England
summary:
Five residential properties with period features and architectural interest have been listed for sale across England, with prices ranging from £595,000 to £1.995 million. The listings include a converted Methodist chapel in Cheshire, a gothic revival home in Devon, and a former fisher's cottage in Norfolk.

title: Hampshire Trust Bank provides £4.2m for farm conversion
summary:
Hampshire Trust Bank has provided £4.2 million in development finance to Dellans Farm Ltd for the conversion of a former farm site near Romsey, Hampshire, into four detached residential properties. The 20-month facility covers the construction of three four-bedroom barn-style homes and a replacement farmhouse of approximately 3,500 square feet.

title: Conservative mayoral candidate pledges £100,000 price cut
summary:
James Cleverly, the Conservative candidate for the 2028 London mayoral election, has pledged to reduce new build property prices in the capital by £100,000 through cuts to regulatory costs and taxation. The former Shadow Housing Secretary claims bureaucracy and taxes add approximately £100,000 to new build costs in London.

title: UK rental supply reaches seven-year high in 2026
summary:
UK rental property supply has increased by 10.4% in 2026, reaching a seven-year high with 118,100 additional properties entering the market. Supply growth has outpaced tenant demand by nearly four times, with demand rising just 2.7% over the same period.

title: 27% of renters now borrowing money to pay deposits
summary:
More than a quarter of renters in the UK are borrowing money to pay their tenancy deposits, according to new research. The study found that 27% of renters now use debt that must be repaid to cover their deposits, up from 20% in 2025.

The post 27% of renters now borrowing money to pay deposits appeared first on PropertyWire.

title: UK property transactions forecast to rise 6.7% in 2027
summary:
UK property transactions are expected to decline by 4.4% in 2026 before recovering with a 6.7% increase in 2027, according to forecasts from EXP UK. England is projected to lead the recovery while Scotland faces consecutive annual declines.

The post UK property transactions forecast to rise 6.7% in 2027 appeared first on PropertyWire.

title: Homeowners spend £630 annually on parents’ properties
summary:
Homeowners in Britain are spending an average of £630 per year maintaining their parents' properties, with those aged 35 to 44 spending up to £862 annually. Research from Zoopla found that 64% of homeowners with parents aged 65 or above have helped maintain their parent's home in the past year, dedicating approximately 64 hours annually to the task.

title: UK property market slows as mortgage rates impact activity
summary:
The UK housing market is experiencing a slowdown in price growth and sales activity, with higher mortgage rates affecting buyer behaviour across most regions, according to the latest data from major property indices. Recent market data reveals a mixed picture, with sellers facing increased challenges while buyers gain negotiating power.
